[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Johne and Issobel Glasgow were baptized on 03-Feb-1648 in Mid Calder parish. They were the children of [[Glasgow-2453|William Glasgow]]. As they were baptized on the same day, they were probably twins. 

Johne Glasgow was born in 1648. He is the son of [[Glasgow-2453|William Glasgow]].

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1087]] is assessed at 79% (probable). The reported Mid Calder OPR 694/10/94 child entry, 3 February 1648, names Johne and father William Glasgow. The same parish and a paternal age around thirty-eight make the 1609 William the best identified candidate for the adult named in this 1648 event; the merged 2453 account preserves that comparison.

Probable full-profile identification; the entry itself names only William. Johne and Issobell’s shared date/reference does not alone establish twins.

Next useful test: Compare the original 1609 and 1648 entries for residence and family associates.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2452 Baptism record for Johne Glasgow, 03-Feb-1648, Mid Calder parish, ScotlandsPeople.gov.uk, church registers, parish number 694, Ref: 10/94.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
